name: AISLER
notes: AISLER's official design rules now live in their community knowledge base (the old aisler.net/help/design-rules-and-specifications URL redirects there). Rules depend on layer count, copper weight (35/70 um) and finish (HASL/ENIG); the old 'Beautiful Boards' naming is no longer used. Small drills (<0.3 mm), castellations and fine tracks require ENIG. Pages updated 07/07/2025 (2L/4L 35um), 05/12/2025 (6L+), 19/08/2026 (4L 70um HASL). Via annular ring is per the rules; via_diameter derived as drill + 2 x ring.

value_notes.pth_drill: "min. PTH drill size 0.5 mm"; smaller holes are vias (max via drill 0.45 mm).
value_notes.pth_annular_ring: "min. PTH annular ring 300 um / 12 mil" (label missing on the HASL pages, value identical).
value_notes.npth_drill: Unlabelled NPTH row in the table: 0.5 mm min / 5.6 mm max.
value_notes.max_drill: "max. PTH drill size 5.6 mm" (NPTH max also 5.6 mm).
value_notes.hole_to_copper: Published only as "min. spacing NPTH / copper 250 um" (NPTH slot to copper 300 um). No separate PTH-to-copper rule.
value_notes.edge_clearance: "min. copper to edge clearance 300 um / 12 mil"
value_notes.mask_bridge: "min. soldermask dam 100 um" - dam between pads "required for HASL"
value_notes.plated_slot_width: "min. PTH slot diameter 0.7 mm" (max 2.6 mm on the rules pages, 2.7 mm on the slots page); PTH slot annular ring 300 um.
value_notes.npth_slot_width: "min. NPTH slot diameter 0.8 mm"; preferred >= 1.8 mm (milled); keep 0.3 mm to copper.
value_notes.smd_pad_to_pad: No pad-to-pad rule; copper/copper spacing applies. Min SMD pad size is published separately.
value_notes.track_width: "min. tracewidth 200 um / 8 mil"; spacing 150 um / 6 mil
value_notes.via_drill: "min. via drill 0.3 mm" (HASL); max via drill 0.45 mm
